card.name: Small linking words in old prose
card.fires_on: The word "of" after a noun like parts, course, sum or grandeur in older or literary English. Also some punctuation, such as a period after an abbreviation or an opening parenthesis in anatomy lists.

modes.label: "of" after a noun
modes.description: The word "of" follows a noun such as parts, course, grandeur or sum, in 19th-century style prose.

modes.label: Punctuation in anatomy text
modes.description: A period, "Figs." dot or opening parenthesis in old anatomy descriptions and name lists.

card.plain: It fires on the small word "of" in older literary or scientific prose, as in "parts of the world".
